column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 1 town residents, shop, and slave-check interactions
# Verified generic map-interaction voices; no manual wrapping.

column2: What...?!
You're a $$奴隷$$—don't talk to me while you're standing!
Why are you wandering around alone? Don't tell me you're some $$野良奴隷$$!
Why are you talking to me?!
I'm not someone...
you can casually talk to!!
Sorry, I'm in a hurry...
If I'm late, my $$ご主人様$$ will beat me badly!
What? Don't talk to me! They'll think I'm slacking off!
(That guy's lucky...)
(He can walk around without being scolded...!)
I'm still a merchant—I don't do business with the likes of you!
Hey, welco—!?
What, white $$羽$$? You running an errand?
What do you want?
Hold it. First show me what your $$飼い主$$ entrusted you with—
your $$商品購入・委任証明書$$!
You fool!! Go get it, now!
Hmm...
You're certainly a strange sort of $$奴隷$$!
You've got a very evil-looking face!
Who the hell are you?!
Where's your $$飼い主$$?
Enough—show me your $$奴隷認識票$$!!
Don't tell me you're a $$逃亡奴隷$$?!
...What?!
You do have one after all!!
Let's see, you've had your vaccinations...
I see...!!
So you're the $$奴隷$$ owned by that $$オカルト$$-mad freak who lives up on the hill!!
No wonder you're a strange $$奴隷$$ wearing clothes!
Why's a $$奴隷$$ like you wearing clothes?!
Besides, people say something's wrong with your $$ご主人様$$!
Rumor has it they even eat at the same table with $$奴隷$$s...
and works alongside them too!
But honestly, I'm jealous of your $$ご主人様$$.
Because unlike our $$ご主人様$$s, who knock us down out of nowhere,
work us to death...
then just bury us somewhere...
that doesn't happen to you, right?!
Be careful...!
If we $$奴隷$$s are found walking around without our $$ご主人様$$s...
and without our $$首輪$$s...
the $$異端審問官$$s will grab us immediately,
and not just you, but your $$ご主人様$$ too,
will face terrible punishment!!
